description: Which House members filed their stock-trade reports late, ranked across the WHOLE House for a filing-date window: per member the number of transactions, how many were filed more than 45 days after the trade (the STOCK Act limit), late share, average and worst days-to-file. Use for "which members filed late this quarter", "worst late filers in the House this year". House only; computed from the Clerk of the House's own filings, with a coverage block stating how many filings could not be read.

from.description: Earliest FILING date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 90 days ago.

min_transactions.description: Only members with at least this many transactions in the window. Default 3.

to.description: Latest FILING date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

name: house_ptr_late_filers
